name: Poison Sumac
desc: Poison Sumac (Toxicodendron vernix): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Toxicodendron vernix, commonly known as poison sumac, or swamp-sumach, is a woody shrub or small tree growing to 9 metres (30 feet) tall. It was previously known as Rhus vernix.
